entries.gave: Read docs/product-vision.md as its people meet it: two roles, O1 and O2 each with a well and a fast key result, and a concept of three ideas, two of them tagged for both O1 and O2.
Read N4 and N5 in the product-vision best practice, with their reasons and practices.

N4 good: each objective has a failure-share and a time key result, directions given, well ranked before fast. N5 more: two concept ideas are marked as serving both O1 and O2, so a piece of work does not map to one objective.
